d:
Just an attempt to find out where the limits of what is currently possible lie. I tried to capture the author's intent and style as accurately as possible.
I've achieved the goal I set for myself: to bring the storyline about the first girl to life. I learned a lot from that. My conclusion is that consistency is the hardest thing to achieve. But hardcore scenes are definitely possible locally.
